source_contract: SeoView auto-runs when useActiveTab reports a new URL; useActiveTab refreshes on tabs.onUpdated without a status=complete gate. captureWithFallback sends SCRAPE_CAPTURE immediately and does not wait for page load. The collector maps navigation duration 0 or absent to null, and SeoDetails omits the Load duration row when null. docs/feature-tests.md says Performance shows whichever values the browser exposed. No source contract found that promises post-load timing for an automatic audit.
root_ruling: The automatic URL audit is a point-in-time snapshot; there is no requirement that it expose post-load timing before the browser makes timing available. Exact detail acceptance belongs to an explicit manual Re-audit after page load.
prepared_runner_change: The runner still requires the automatic audit to settle on the selected URL/title and records its observed counts and performance as diagnostics without marking exact-data passes. It then reads the public DOM and navigation timing before a trusted manual Re-audit, observes the disabled-running and settled transitions, reads the public DOM/timing again, and fails if the independent before/after source snapshots differ. All exact link, image, readability, performance, and outbound-door predicates now use the manual audit and stable public source. No broad catch, count-matching retry, or product change was added.
